findings.defect: 마나 적응도 refers to their degree of adaptation to mana, not necessarily an innate affinity for it. “Affinity” changes the basis on which Lee Jungryong selected and trained them.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly says they were raised as personal guards according to their mana-adaptation level.
findings.replacement: according to how well they adapted to mana

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, with two minor terminology-sense issues.
